scheme.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
scheme.implementing_agency: MoMSME, MoSD&E, DFS, Common Service Centres (CSCs)
scheme.description: Provides PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card, basic training (5-7 days), advanced training (15+ days), stipend Rs 500/day during training, toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, collateral-free loans at 5% interest (Tranche 1: up to Rs 1 lakh/18 months; Tranche 2: up to Rs 2 lakh/30 months), digital transaction incentive Rs 1/transaction up to 100 per month, marketing support. Early repayment restriction: not before 6 months from disbursement. Helpline: 1800 267 7777. Family = husband, wife, unmarried children; only 1 per family can apply.
scheme.voice_summary: PM Vishwakarma supports artisans in 18 traditional trades with a certificate, training with a stipend, a 15000 rupee toolkit incentive, and loans at 5 percent interest.
benefits: First tranche: collateral-free loan up to Rs 1 lakh at 5% interest for 18 months

online: Three-tier verification: Stage 1 Gram Panchayat / ULB verification; Stage 2 District Implementation Committee; Stage 3 Screening Committee.
online: Upon approval, download PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card.
online: Undergo 5-7 days basic skill training (Rs 500/day stipend).
online: Receive Rs 15,000 toolkit digital e-voucher and apply for Enterprise Development Loan (Tranche 1: Rs 1 Lakh at 5% interest).

faqs.question: What trades and benefits are covered under PM Vishwakarma?
faqs.answer: Covers 18 traditional trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, weavers, etc.). Benefits include PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, basic skill training with Rs 500/day stipend, Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to Rs 3 Lakh (Rs 1 Lakh tranche 1, Rs 2 Lakh tranche 2) at a concessional 5% interest rate.

catalog_descriptions.en: PM Vishwakarma supports artisans in 18 traditional trades with a certificate, training with a stipend, a 15000 rupee toolkit incentive, and loans at 5 percent interest.
catalog_descriptions.hi: प्रधानमंत्री विश्वकर्मा 18 पारंपरिक व्यवसायों में कारीगरों को एक प्रमाण पत्र, एक वजीफे के साथ प्रशिक्षण, 15000 रुपये के टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन और 5 प्रतिशत ब्याज पर ऋण के साथ सहायता प्रदान करते हैं।
catalog_descriptions.ta: பிரதமர் விஸ்வகர்மா 18 பாரம்பரிய தொழில்களில் கைவினைஞர்களுக்கு சான்றிதழ், உதவித்தொகை பயிற்சி, 15000 ரூபாய் கருவித்தொகுப்பு ஊக்கத்தொகை மற்றும் 5 சதவீத வட்டியில் கடன் வழங்குகிறார்.
